release.content: pubkit 0.14.3 was released on 2026-10-27 from commit eb5dd58253e4f9d241cc44cf0c03f7112fd78de7 with these changes.

rows: pubkit board grades every repository protected.json and governed.json list, public and private, A to E for quality, security and delivery, into board.json and a static index.html whose grade breakdowns open on hover or focus. Quality and Security start at SonarQube Cloud's letters and Delivery at A, each losing a letter per notch by src/pubkit/board/rules.json (or --rules FILE), never below E; the overall grade is the worst. One connector per source (lists, github, actions, sonarcloud, scorecard, live) records every call, and board.json links each fact and notch to its calls; --record and --replay keep and reuse the responses. A service declares its health URL, live-test and deploy workflows in pubkit.json's live block. The reusable workflow board.yml runs it with a read-only token and keeps board.json as an artifact for 90 days
